note: Independent whole-row source rejudgment, 2026-10-08. Read RFC 4271 Section 5.1.2 in full: the external-advertisement condition covers leading AS_SEQUENCE prepend, a new leading AS_SEQUENCE on 255-member overflow, a new AS_SEQUENCE before a leading AS_SET, and construction of an AS_SEQUENCE when the AS_PATH is empty. The same section defines an empty AS_PATH by a zero attribute length, not absence. Read every current tagged carrier: TestEstablishedAnnounce_ExplicitASPath_PrependsLocalAS and TestEstablishedAnnounce_ExplicitASPath_IBGPVerbatim, both TestASPathSlotPrependOnlyWhenAdvertising covers, TestASPathSlotPrependsBeforeALeadingASSet, TestASPathSlotStartsANewSegmentWhenTheLeadingOneIsFull, TestForwardPresentEmptyASPath, and both checkRelayWithdrawalShape covers. The retained sequence test checks [65000,65001,65002]; the set test checks both segment types and exact members; overflow checks a new [65000] sequence and a retained 255-member segment. Its retained-member assertion is count-only, not a full original-content comparison, and the retained iBGP case compares decoded numbers, not original TLV bytes; no stronger evidence is claimed. The advertisement/withdrawal pair prevents an unconditional prepend or an entirely disabled mechanism from passing. The former absent-attribute test remains intact but correctly no longer claims the empty-path clause. The new consumer root supplies explicit 40 02 00, follows notifyMessageReceiver through ForwardUpdate or reactorForwardRS to the real Session writer, and requires exactly one recipient UPDATE, unchanged NLRI and source bytes, and exactly 02 01 fd e8 or 02 01 00 00 fd e8 for ordinary external recipients. Internal and RS-client controls require the attribute to remain present and empty. Both forward producers construct the external-only intent; ASPathEdit.Record selects recordPrepend, its present-attribute branch parses the zero-length value, and attribute.ASPath.Prepend creates the one-member sequence. These are the formerly unexercised producer and consumer branches. Saved evidence read: job-joint-schema-ipv4-self-empty-aspath-race20-a9d2bfd1.log has 20 passes of this root, not a package pass; job-present-empty-aspath-selective-semantic-red-ecbbbd92.log fails all four external exact-byte cases while all eight internal/RS controls pass; job-present-empty-aspath-restored-consumer-91fea142.log restores all twelve passes. job-present-empty-aspath-native-binding-b6c62391.log separately records a producer-disabled panic at Prepend; this is a reachability binding, not a substitute for the selective semantic failure. The registered FRR checker requires the exact relayed path and positively decoded withdrawal without an attribute error and with a surviving session; its source was read, but no fresh interop execution is claimed. The concrete absent-versus-present-empty proof hole is closed, and the retained carriers cover the remaining conditional branches. Upgrade weak to enforced for this row only; this is not a claim about all RFC 4271 behavior, prepend-none/no-empty configuration variants, or whole-package race success.
